owner_component_only_contract.expiry: Private token separate from lease reference; legacy PIDreleasecasts ignored

controls.title: Missing actual default KeyOwner denies startup admission
controls.mechanism: Start fixed repos without the registered actual KeyOwner; no fake process name stand-in.
controls.expected: No storage_ready; bootstrap/load fail closed.

controls.title: Missing actual fixed LifecycleRepo or ordinary Repo denies admission
controls.mechanism: Start only each proper subset of fixed registered children.
controls.expected: No usable lease or SQL effect.

controls.title: Actual LifecycleRepo startup binding, env drift and dynamic selection
controls.mechanism: Require the protected init-created ETS table owner to be the actual registered fixed Repo PID, reject missing/stale/foreign-owned table and altered complete startup-option fingerprints; mutate Application config independently and test wrong dynamic repo.
controls.expected: Actual lifecycle startup credentials/policy covered; no substituted connection/fallback; ordinary Repo config observation is not claimed as live-startup attestation.

controls.title: Startup requires current function V2 AND relation admission
controls.mechanism: Mutate one surface at a time before owner startup, then restore in the disposable database.
controls.expected: Either partial admission fails; only conjunction can establish internal storage_ready.

controls.title: Fixed registration, exact configured shape and startup authority
controls.mechanism: Exercise disabled/malformed settings, duplicate owner registration, forged startup invocation and direct Store admission from a foreign caller.
controls.expected: No alternative owner name/caller or struct-shape authority; honest disabled/unavailable state.

controls.title: Direct Store operation without live retained lease denies
controls.mechanism: Call fixed Store functions with closed valid-looking draft/input but no owner-reserved lease.
controls.expected: Redacted admission failure and no write.

controls.title: Forged lease or added field denies
controls.mechanism: Construct a copied struct or map with a made-up reference or extra key.
controls.expected: No supplied PID/map/process dictionary may grant authority.

controls.title: Copied lease in another process denies
controls.mechanism: Transfer one actual reserved lease to a separate monitored caller.
controls.expected: Actual GenServer caller mismatch denies without consuming the rightful caller authority incorrectly.
controls.history: Initial3paths failed; corrected finalPG16 preserves originalslots afterfinish/failed/release/legacycast/copiedexpiry/malformedmessages.

controls.title: Altered retained lease field or old generation denies
controls.mechanism: Change each selected lease field independently and use a lease retained across owner generation replacement.
controls.expected: Exact retained equality and generation continuity required.

controls.title: Original caller owns Vault, transaction and publication
controls.mechanism: Observe actual call/SQL process identities during public bootstrap/load without substituting execution.
controls.expected: No GenServer-owned or spawned-worker orchestration and no copied original-caller claim.

controls.title: Nested existing lifecycle transaction denies
controls.mechanism: Invoke public owner operations from an actual fixed LifecycleRepo transaction.
controls.expected: No nesting, savepoint reuse or hidden transaction effect.

controls.title: Nested ordinary transaction denies
controls.mechanism: Invoke public owner operations from an actual MixerHosted.Repo transaction.
controls.expected: Original caller remains visible to rejection; no work relocation bypass.

controls.title: Active ordinary authorization Context denies
controls.mechanism: Bind an actual ordinary Context for a valid synthetic transaction, then invoke bootstrap/load.
controls.expected: No lifecycle acquisition or publication inside ordinary protected work.

controls.title: 32 owner operations admitted and 33rd rejected without permit wait
controls.mechanism: Use exact fixed reserve messages from 32 distinct real callers held outside SQL.
controls.expected: 32 retained leases only; overflow denies; this is not 32-concurrent-SQL evidence.

controls.title: Caller death releases owned permit
controls.mechanism: Kill one of the 32 owned fixture callers and observe monitor cleanup.
controls.expected: Subsequent reservation succeeds; other callers and permits survive.

controls.title: Release, failure, finish and expiry cannot leak or duplicate permits
controls.mechanism: Exercise exact fixed owner messages, double use, stale releases and original deadline expiry.
controls.expected: One cleanup per lease; stale caller/reference cannot release another live permit.

controls.title: Two actual pool connections exhaust with no checkout queue
controls.mechanism: Hold both fixed lifecycle connections using bounded real transactions, then call public bootstrap/load.
controls.expected: Third work fails promptly without waiting for release; pool bound remains two.

controls.title: Lifecycle pressure preserves ordinary fixed Repo
controls.mechanism: While lifecycle pool is full, issue an ordinary independent synthetic query.
controls.expected: Ordinary connection remains usable and no fallback supplies lifecycle capacity.

controls.title: RuntimeOwner death or registered replacement denies held work
controls.mechanism: Suspend an observed owned request, terminate/replace the manually started owner, then resume.
controls.expected: No private result/cookie from old generation; no retry or automatic recovery.

controls.title: Actual default KeyOwner death or PID replacement denies
controls.mechanism: Terminate/replace the actual registered default KeyOwner while an observed request is held.
controls.expected: Readiness clears; held work cannot publish. No same-PID trust-generation claim.

controls.title: Lifecycle Repo death or replacement denies held work
controls.mechanism: Terminate/replace only the fixed fixture lifecycle Repo during a held operation.
controls.expected: Old pool PID/config work denied; unknown effect is not replayed.

controls.title: Config and registered owner continuity are rechecked at release
controls.mechanism: Use observed caller suspension to change only disposable owner/config state or registration between SQL and private publication.
controls.expected: No stale digest/runtime/config/PID result; instrumentation scope is explicit.

controls.title: Bootstrap exactly matches retained server draft
controls.mechanism: Create a real preauth row through public bootstrap and inspect it using an operator assertion connection.
controls.expected: Exact browser/cookie/CSRF/config/generation/counter/deadline/cipher match; only SQL-owned fresh timestamps/audit vary.

controls.title: Real Vault seal and open straddle transactions
controls.mechanism: Observe actual Vault calls and the fixed Repo transaction state for bootstrap then load.
controls.expected: Seal precedes transaction; load commit precedes open; canonical43 CSRF and exact StoredSnapshot roundtrip.

controls.title: Only admitted load SQL NULL returns ok nil
controls.mechanism: Use unknown/terminal/expired/config-mismatching cookie states that the fixed admitted helper returns NULL for.
controls.expected: Exactly {:ok,nil}; non-NULL failures never become nil.

controls.title: Non-NULL active, malformed or conflicting-attempt snapshot denies
controls.mechanism: Seed bounded operator-created fixture rows or observe post-admission drift while preserving unchanged candidate source.
controls.expected: Redacted failure; no active secret/auth/workspace result or invented attempt resumption.

controls.title: Closed metadata, raw cookie and typed Store inputs
controls.mechanism: Exercise exact request_id hex32, cookie canonical bounds, extra/absent fields and wrong types.
controls.expected: Invalid inputs deny before effect; no callback/Repo/clock/provider or destination selection.

controls.title: Source, context, cipher and CSRF binding failures deny
controls.mechanism: Alter each durable source/AAD/cipher/key-id/tag/CSRF/profile/version/config field in isolated synthetic rows and separately present valid but foreign envelopes.
controls.expected: AEAD success alone cannot satisfy retained source equality; all mismatches deny.

controls.title: Function/type drift after startup is detected per transaction
controls.mechanism: Alter one fixed function source/config/ACL/type after successful startup; restore before next independent control.
controls.expected: Current V2 function admission denies with no helper effect.

controls.title: Relation/policy/constraint/trigger/role drift is detected per transaction
controls.mechanism: Apply one representative relation/policy/constraint/trigger/role mutation after startup.
controls.expected: Current relation admission denies independently of function admission.

controls.title: Both admissions and effect retain the same owned connection
controls.mechanism: Observe backend identity/transaction marker across actual function and relation checks and helper execution.
controls.expected: No cached or separate-transaction partial result authorizes effect.

controls.title: Exact LOCAL settings and READ COMMITTED restore on every exit
controls.mechanism: Record observed transaction settings and connection settings before/after success, effect failure and commit failure.
controls.expected: Catalog-admitted settings exactly match, are LOCAL, and do not leak across pooled transactions.

controls.title: Original deadline begins before reservation, draft and seal
controls.mechanism: Trace the unchanged public entry/reserve/Vault sequence and delay an observed caller before transaction.
controls.expected: One initial five-second budget; no newly created SQL deadline.

controls.title: Checkout uses original absolute deadline and remaining timeout
controls.mechanism: Combine pre-checkout caller delay with a full fixed pool.
controls.expected: No queued acquisition or timeout reset; deny by original deadline.

controls.title: Catalog work consumes the original budget
controls.mechanism: Hold an observed catalog-stage caller or bounded catalog-related operator lock.
controls.expected: Remaining positive query budgets shrink and cannot reset the original deadline.

controls.title: Effect lock wait cannot extend the initial deadline
controls.mechanism: Introduce real bounded row/relation lock contention after observed current admission.
controls.expected: Actual wait/error is bounded by original absolute deadline and no retry occurs.

controls.title: Post-transaction Vault/open/result work cannot publish after deadline
controls.mechanism: Suspend actual caller after confirmed load commit but before final private release.
controls.expected: Expired monotonic budget or durable expiry denies even after successful DB work.

controls.title: Deferred COMMIT error rolls back all bootstrap writes
controls.mechanism: At observed post-catalog/pre-effect checkpoint confirm no write, add disposable deferred rejecting trigger as operator, then resume unchanged candidate.
controls.expected: Error arises at actual COMMIT; no row/audit write persists; phase/outcome redacted and accurate.

controls.title: Actual COMMIT timeout/disconnect returns unknown without retry
controls.mechanism: Use deferred bounded delay plus real backend termination or local transport fault at observed commit boundary.
controls.expected: No cookie/private success, SQL replay or fresh reconstructed cookie; readiness is invalidated as selected.
controls.clarification: A received PostgreSQL severityERROR57014 can prove rollback; driver/FATAL/PANIC outcome loss remains unknown. Timeout is not automatically unknown.

controls.title: Confirmed commit followed by response/result loss has no cookie recovery
controls.mechanism: Drop response or hold/kill original caller only after independent durable commit evidence.
controls.expected: Committed row may remain, but no result reconstruction or automatic recovery/retry.

controls.title: Wall rollback and expiry equality fail closed
controls.mechanism: Use real durable expiry/equality cases and explicit test-only owner component messages for backward wall continuity; never change host wall clock.
controls.expected: No expiry equality pass; component wall-message checks are not fake-clock end-to-end evidence.

controls.title: Closed results and actual owner diagnostics redact state and messages
controls.mechanism: Collect safe assertion fingerprints for success/failure/Inspect, actual :sys.get_status and an abnormal owned GenServer termination with synthetic state/message/reason/debug sentinels.
controls.expected: No raw cookie/CSRF/key/password/reference/cipher/SQL exception/private identity in errors, Inspect, sys status or crash output; direct format_status-only testing is insufficient.

controls.title: Actual logs and telemetry preserve redaction
controls.mechanism: Capture safe owned fixture logger/telemetry assertions during positive, SQL-error, timeout and connection-error controls; distinguish standard trusted Repo-init metadata from fixed Store query events and never persist raw startup opts.
controls.expected: No secret/cipher/query-parameter sentinel in log or persisted receipt; explicit sensitive-query telemetry suppression verified since log:false alone is insufficient.

controls.title: Allowlisted source closure and all owned resource cleanup
controls.mechanism: Seal selected source/dependency inputs before/after partitions; terminate only owned PG/BEAM/tracer/proxy resources on every exit.
controls.expected: No frozen/broad harness import; source drift invalidates affected results; owned processes/ports gone and unrelated processes preserved.

pre_freeze_findings.topic: Ecto query telemetry is not suppressed by log:false
pre_freeze_findings.implication: Sensitive fixed Store queries need explicit telemetry suppression or an equally accepted control; unchanged Catalog relation queries have no sealed-secret inputs.

pre_freeze_findings.topic: Standard trusted Ecto Repo-init telemetry includes full startup options
pre_freeze_findings.implication: No claim that all internal telemetry metadata is credential-free; no unredacted capture/persistence of startup opts/password.

acceptance_scope: Manual fixed preauth bootstrap/load only; not complete44/40/18matrices or startup/authentication/GA
